business_problem: Imagination AI , part of Imagination Holdings, builds a portfolio of next-generation consumer applications across health, social media, and knowledge management. The company focuses on embedding adaptive, context-aware AI throughout its products and creation workflows.
solution_summary: Its technical recommendations significantly reduced BigQuery query and warehousing costs while transferring critical data engineering capabilities to internal teams. By staging raw source files in Cloud Storage and deploying web applications with Firebase App Hosting , Imagination AI established a unified, cost-efficient infrastructure. Combined with Gemini, this resilient Google Cloud foundation ensures the company can continuously iterate, launch context-aware applications, and scale its long-term vision for AI innovation. To build a structured, repeatable development model, Imagination AI selected Google Cloud to build its internal AI Design Spec Coach. Working alongside Google Cloud partner Tridorian to align foundational architecture, the team harnessed Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to output typed, schema-constrained artifacts rather than conversational chat.
